reason: A Chinese-first tutorial repository that teaches users to create DeepSeek Harness skills and TypeScript plugins, with 22 example skills and related installation and diagnostic tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向初学者的 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发教程，提供技能与 TypeScript 插件示例以及安装和诊断工具。
summaries.en: A beginner-oriented DeepSeek Harness plugin development tutorial with skill and TypeScript plugin examples plus installation and diagnostic tools.

capabilities: Provides tutorials and example skills for developing DeepSeek Harness plugins
Provides guidance for code plugins, testing, debugging, project planning, documentation, and web research
Includes an installer that copies example skill files and supports dry-run and uninstall modes
Includes a read-only configuration health-check tool
